# Fetch full content for movie recommendations note and parse movie titles
simple_note_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
email = 'joyce-weav@gmail.com'
login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username=email, password=simple_note_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
print('NOTE TITLE:', note.get('title'))
print('CONTENT:\n', content)

# Parse titles: assume lines after header that start with non-bullet and not containing ':'
# We'll take lines that are not empty, not start with '#', not start with '-' and not contain 'director' or 'genre'
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines()]
movie_titles=[]
for ln in lines:
    if not ln:
        continue
    low=ln.lower()
    if low.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if ln.startswith('-'):
        continue
    if ':' in ln:
        continue
    if any(w in low for w in ['director','genre']):
        continue
    # candidate title
    movie_titles.append(ln)

# Deduplicate preserving order
seen=set(); titles=[]
for t in movie_titles:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); titles.append(t)

print('PARSED TITLES:', titles)
print('COUNT:', len(titles))

page_index = 0

msgs = []
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(
        access_token=access_token,
        phone_number=christopher_phone,
        only_latest_per_contact=True,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
